roleContext.jobDescription: Ormsby Facilities maintains heating, ventilation and electrical systems for schools and council buildings. The Field Service Operations Coordinator schedules engineers against contract deadlines, administers the job-dispatch system, introduces system changes into live operation with a documented cut-over plan, supports engineers and controllers through the first live weeks and reports performance to the contracts manager. Around 120 engineers cover about 900 sites, the control room works from 7 am to 8 pm on weekdays with an out-of-hours desk, and the coordinator works with the operations manager, the IT team and the contracts manager.

requirements.text: Schedules field engineers against service-level deadlines.
Administers the job-dispatch or field-service management system.
Has introduced a system change into live operation with a documented cut-over and supported users through the first live weeks.
Trains engineers and controllers on new processes.
Reports first-time-fix and attendance performance to the contracts manager.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Field Service Operations Coordinator

## Experience

- Service Controller, Pellow Mechanical Services, January 2021 to September 2024. Scheduled 85 field engineers across two regions against four-hour and next-day attendance deadlines, using the scheduling board in the field-service management system.
- Administered user accounts, job types and the skills matrix in the field-service management system, and kept the engineer skills list aligned with training records.
- Moved all 85 engineers from paper job sheets to the mobile job-dispatch app at the April 2024 cut-over, working to the cut-over plan the operations manager had approved, with paper job sheets kept as a fallback for one week.
- Ran 12 training sessions on the mobile app for engineers and controllers, using a test copy of the dispatch system loaded with dummy jobs, ending each session with a short quiz.
- Compiled a monthly attendance report against contract deadlines for the contracts manager, broken down by building type and region.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the cut-over plan for the job-dispatch app, setting out the weekend timeline for 13 and 14 April 2024, data-migration checks, rollback criteria and the operations manager's approval signature, plus a contact list for the weekend.
